--- NI::DSP::EQ_Param::setFilter() @ 0x27988c   (python3 $RE/disasm.py "$BIN" --dump '^NI::DSP::EQ_Param::setFilter\(')
2798b0  ldr s1,[x0,#0x8] ; fadd s10,s1,s1               s10 = 2*fs
2798cc  mov w8,#0x8000 ; movk w8,#0x483b,lsl #16 ; fcmp s1,s0       fs > 192000 ?
2798e4  mov w8,#0x42480000 (50.0)                        -> frequency floor 50 Hz
2798f4  movk w8,#0x47bb,lsl #16 (96000.0) ; fmov s1,#25.0 ; fmaxnm   fs > 96000 -> floor 25 Hz
279918  mov w8,#0xfdb ; movk w8,#0x40c9,lsl #16 (6.2831855) ; fmul s1,s1,s2 ; ... fdiv s1,s1,s10
        w = 2*pi*f/(2*fs) = pi*f/fs is stored at +0x150. No call to tan: the bilinear constant is used without pre-warping.
27992c  fcvt d5,s3 ; fdiv d6,-1,d5 ; fadd d5,d5,d6 ; fsqrt s6,s4 ; fdiv d5,d5,d7     k = (B - 1/B)/sqrt(G), in double
processBuffer @ 0x26fdf0..0x26fec0, per sample: D = 1 + w^2 + k*w ; a1 = 2(w^2-1)/D ; a2 = (1+w^2-k*w)/D ; N = 1 + w^2 + G*k*w ; b1 = 2(w^2-1)/N ; b2 = (1+w^2-G*k*w)/N
onSetSampleRate @ 0x27983c: nTicks = max(1, round(0.02*fs/ctrlBlock)) ; inc = 1/(nTicks*ctrlBlock)   (20 ms linear ramp of w, k, G, volume, mix)
